summary: One repo holding REQ-900-widgets.md and codex-session-scrollback.md: asserts CLI 'lint'/'cover' exit 0 plus positive discovery (covered contains an ID from each grammar), then breaks one spec per grammar and requires lint exit 1 with violations attributed to both files, then drops one annotation per grammar and requires cover exit 1 with both IDs uncovered; filtering either grammar out of lint, or file-scoped specs out of computeCoverage, fails this test.
